## Why

Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-185558-0ab6 for S575 (discovered from S575):

Mid-pattern `*` in `git -C * SUBCMD*` read-only entries matches write commands that end in the subcommand name
My probe ran `allowlistMatches` against the current list. `Bash(git -C * merge-base*)` matches `git -C /w commit -m merge-base`, and the existing `Bash(git -C * show*)` matches `git -C /w commit -m show`. This is PLAUSIBLE for the real Claude Code matcher; CONFIRMED only for the test model at `perm_test.go:18-28`. The weakness already existed for diff, log, status, show and ls-files, and the owner chose this exact entry form in adj 574, so it is not a fix in this slice. It does strain the Check's "No write form of git is newly allowed". A follow-up could add negative cases such as `git -C /w commit -m merge-base` to the batch test, and pick a tighter form if the real matcher behaves the same way.
